How to Access Settings If Hidden

If you hide the app icon, you can always open these settings anytime from Android Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard > Sample Keyboard, or via the Settings button on the keyboard itself.
The launcher icon will be removed from your home screen and app drawer.\n\nYou will still be able to open settings directly from Android Keyboard Settings or the keyboard itself.
